_comment: Golden fixture for the Ant Media Enterprise REST JWT (SEC-188).
The same token format is implemented twice, in two languages:
Both test suites assert against this file, so a change to either side that
alters a byte fails a test instead of failing production auth with a 403
that looks like the IP-allowlist problem in the deploy notes.
If you change the token format deliberately, change BOTH implementations and
recompute `token` — do not edit one side to make its own test pass.
